  WHY: It is greedy and end-anchored, so multi-number lines can capture the last number and trailing-text variants can fail to match, leaving only a cosmetic diagnostic issue.

  WHY: If Codex outputs a line like `tokens used 12345` with no trailing whitespace, the regex does not match and the token count shows as "—".
